request: GPT CHAT #40 safe preflight for main Host checkout fast-forward, protected registry hash and stash count (no merge yet)

bounded_host_request.command:
set -e
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "96d01bb845152569658ccd1187b502bf33649c06"
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
test "$(git stash list | wc -l)" -eq 3
before="$(sha256sum operations/master-internal-repositories.json | awk '{print $1}')"
git fetch --no-tags origin main
git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD FETCH_HEAD
echo PRECHECK_MAIN_FAST_FORWARD_PASS
printf 'CURRENT_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'REMOTE_TARGET='; git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD
printf 'REGISTRY_HASH_PREFIX='; printf '%s\n' "$before" | cut -c1-12
printf 'STASH_COUNT='; git stash list | wc -l
printf 'CHANGED_FILES='; git diff --name-only HEAD FETCH_HEAD | wc -l
echo PROTECTED_DIFF_BEGIN
git diff --name-only HEAD FETCH_HEAD -- operations/master-internal-repositories.json
echo PROTECTED_DIFF_END
